meta.title: Every lineage, on the record.
meta.description: Accession Book is the system of record for genetic material: lineage, custody, quality holds, recall and inspection-ready reporting for laboratories, breeders and licensed producers.

hero.lead: Accession Book is the system of record for genetic material. Lineage, custody, quality holds and recall live in the data model, so an inspection is a report you run, not a week you lose.

lineage.label: Lineage
lineage.body: Every unit links to its parent. Trace a clone, a seed lot or a cell line back to its source in one query.

custody.label: Custody
custody.body: Scan-confirmed transfers between rooms, with who moved what, and when.

audit.label: Audit
audit.body: Append-only history. Every change keeps its author, its reason, and its before and after.

platform.title: Three things a compliance system has to get right
platform.intro: Most inventory tools record what you typed. These are the guarantees that hold up when a regulator, a recall or a failed test arrives.

lineage.title: Lineage that survives the question
lineage.body: Every unit is a chain of states with a real parent link, not a note in a comment field. Ask where a gram came from and the answer is a query, not an afternoon.
lineage.caption: One source lot. Three derived units. The parent link is the record.
lineage.scene: A source lot splitting into three derived units

holds.title: Holds that actually hold
holds.body: A failed result freezes the unit on the spot. It cannot be moved, split or destroyed until someone with authority releases it, and the release is signed.
holds.caption: The result is written first. The hold is a consequence, not a status someone typed.
holds.scene: A failed potency result placing a unit on hold

recall.title: Recall in a single pass
recall.body: Trace backward to the source and forward to every derived child, then pull remaining related inventory and linked shipments in the same result.
recall.caption: Backward to the source, forward to what is still on hand and what already left.
recall.scene: A recall from a source unit to stock on hand and a shipment

industries.title: One core. Any regulated material.
industries.intro: The record is the same whatever you track: a unit, where it came from, who touched it, what it tested at, and where it went. What changes by industry is the vocabulary and the statutory return, so those live in a pack on top of the core.
industries.packsNote: The lifecycle vocabulary and the statutory return that sit on top of the core.

cannabis.name: Cannabis, Canada
cannabis.detail: Cultivation lifecycle, CTLS monthly inventory returns and a witnessed destruction register, using the vocabulary of Canadian cannabis regulation.

plants.name: Plant genetics and agriculture
plants.detail: Propagation, mother lines and seed lots. Runs on the core today; no statutory return is bundled yet.

points.two: Seed lots linked to the source catalogue
points.three: Core traceability, no statutory return bundled

biotech.name: Pharmaceutical and biotech labs
biotech.detail: GxP-aligned records, cell-line lineage and electronic signatures.

food.name: Food and supply-chain traceability
food.detail: Lot genealogy, supplier attestation and one-up, one-down recall.

lifecycle.title: From source to disposition, on one chain
lifecycle.intro: Material enters once and keeps the same identity all the way through. Packaging, transfer and sale extend that chain rather than starting a new one, so growth never means migrating to a second system.

catalogue.label: Source catalogue
catalogue.detail: Your reference library of genetics, strains, varieties or cell lines, linked to every unit you hold.

intake.label: Intake and derivation
intake.detail: Register incoming material, then split, clone or subculture it with the parent link kept intact.

process.label: In-process tracking
process.detail: Stage changes over time, with per-stage durations and the operator who reported each one.

custody.label: Custody and movement
custody.detail: Barcode-confirmed transfers between rooms, with a full location history per unit.

testing.label: Testing and quality
testing.detail: Results scored against your limits, with an automatic hold that freezes the unit on failure.

disposition.label: Disposition
disposition.detail: Witnessed destruction registers and period returns in the format your regulator expects.

packaging.label: Packaging and lots
packaging.detail: Transformation, formulation and finished-lot build with input-to-output reconciliation.

sale.label: Transfer and sale
sale.detail: Wholesale allocation and point of sale, extending the same chain.

units.title: Tracked units
units.body: Any countable or weighable material, with full state history per unit.

derivation.title: Derivation chains
derivation.body: Splits, clones and subcultures recorded as events, back to the source.

custody.title: Barcode custody
custody.body: Room-to-room transfers confirmed by scan, with per-unit location history.

quality.title: Quality and holds
quality.body: Results scored against your limits, with automatic quarantine on failure.

reporting.title: Regulatory reporting
reporting.body: Period returns, destruction registers and exports, printable and as CSV.

audit.title: Field-level audit trail
audit.body: Who changed what, and when, with before and after values on every write.

inventory.title: Inventory accountability
inventory.body: Opening balance, additions, reductions and closing balance per period.

workspace.title: Your own workspace
workspace.body: Your users, locations, catalogue and data, kept apart from everyone else.

compliance.title: Built to be inspected
compliance.p1: Records are written once and never quietly rewritten. Corrections are appended with an author and a reason, destructions carry a witness, and every report links back to the source rows it was built from.
compliance.p2: Nothing is inferred to make a number balance. If a value was never captured, the report says so instead of inventing one.

inventory.title: Period inventory return
inventory.detail: Opening, additions, reductions, closing, per category, from the source rows.

destruction.title: Destruction register
destruction.detail: Date, method, witness and disposition, written once and never quietly rewritten.

custody.title: Chain of custody
custody.detail: Barcode-confirmed transfer, with the operator and the timestamp on the scan.

audit.title: Member activity audit
audit.detail: Field-level before and after on every write, attributed to a person.

cta.title: Start with an empty workspace
cta.body: Your organization gets its own users, locations, catalogue and records. Bring your material, and the chain starts from the first unit you register.

insight.title: See the whole chain without opening a spreadsheet
insight.intro: Custody, stage, quality and audit figures come from the same records as the units themselves, so every number on the page can be traced to its source rows.
insight.caption: Illustrative figures, not customer data

statement.text: Most systems record what you typed. Accession Book records what happened: who handled each unit, what it tested at and where it went, in an order nobody can quietly rewrite.
